notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (8): You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, the frozen Han ('Han Solo/EPP Han'), Heading For The Medical Frigate, Don't Do That Again, Scrambled Transmission and Your Insight Serves You Well; these count toward the 60 (total 60).
Three starting Effects (Don't Do That Again, Scrambled Transmission, Your Insight Serves You Well), so no single starting effect is set; Don't Do That Again was an Effect in 2001.

Posted 'Han Solo/EPP Han (depends on the situation; see strategy)' and 'EPP Han/Han Solo (whichever you didn't start with)' are 'X or Y' lines, kept as written (UNKNOWN); the deck plays one Han Solo and one Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol between them, the strategy recommending starting Han Solo.

Posted 'Jabba's  Palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace (the draft had a second Audience Chamber); 'Your Insights Server You Well' Your Insight Serves You Well (the Staging Areas combo is Reflections III); 'Threepio w/ his Showing Parts' Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'EPP Leia' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Chewie, Protector' Chewbacca, Protector; 'Lando w/ Vibro-Ax' Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'B'onarr Monk' B'omarr Monk; 'Honour of the Jedi' Honor Of The Jedi; 'Weapon Levitation' the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt.
Format Premiere - Tatooine: June 2001 post, no Coruscant cards.
